cards.name: Tabby Card

community_notes.text: Repaying Tabby by credit card may cost up to about 1%; Tabby's own pages do not say so

cards.notes: Virtual BNPL-linked Visa, not a conventional credit card. Tabby Plus (49 a month on Tabby's own card page; currency not shown, AED likely. We previously held AED 59 from a comparison site, which Tabby's page contradicts) gives 5% cashback on 3 selected categories, cap AED 200 a month; categories rotate in-app so not modelled. Up to 40 days to pay statement free; rolling over may cost up to 12%. Collection charges up to AED 200 late. Official Tabby card page read 2026-11-27: no card or annual fees, 5% on 3 chosen categories up to AED 200 a month, up to 40 days to pay. Tabby's pages state no fee for repaying by card; the ~1% fee is a community report only (see data/cards/claims.json).
